reviews.text: They did exactly what I asked for. I was talking to the owner and she really knows her stuff. You can tell there's years of experience in that shop. Will definitely be going back.
Just be very careful around the owner.  I guess experiences with her vary, but to me she is vitriolic and angry

My little one is particularly difficult when getting her nails done but the staff here was so kind, patient, and accommodating. They did a great job with her nails for a great price. Highly recommend.
EV was awesome! I have a 2 Samoyed's and the big thing is she PROPERLY knows how to groom them. No tunnel cuts!
So no I didn't get anything done but she did call me back and let me know her prices and are on availability

We have been going to the shop for a couple of years and every time they do an amazing job on both of our girls.
My girls go in a little uneasy/scared and come out best friends with the staff which means you know they take care to treat them, right. I bring them in there looking a mess and they come out looking like little princesses lol

I was stressing because PetSmart banned my 14 year old dog. But when I called up to Scissors and Suds they immediately reassured me they have the special touch and patience for elderly dogs. They were amazing! Communicated clearly “you have to pay cash or check” plus it didn’t take long at all! I will be back to support this small business.
All I can say is amazing service

Want to start by saying my husband called to see if any openings was my fist time there and customer service was amazing super friendly and knowledgeable my baby boy loved it will be going there from now on highly recommend can see they love to work with animals can’t wait to go back
Awesome experience. Evie and asst,the groomers, were great. Anouk looks great and was extremely comfortable there. Will definitely be Anouk's groomer from now on. THANK YOU EVIE!

I cannot say enough wonderful things about the incredible job they did with my Frenchie! From the moment we arrived, it was clear that this wasn’t just a routine appointment — it was a pampering session tailored with love and professionalism.

My Frenchie can be a bit much (everyone is his new friend, and his wiggles don't stop!), but they handled him with such calm confidence and genuine care. He came home looking absolutely flawless — nails trimmed perfectly, coat shining like velvet, ears clean, and smelling fresh without any overpowering scents. Every detail was attended to with precision.

What truly set this experience apart was how comfortable and happy my pup was when I picked him up. It’s rare to see him so relaxed after a grooming session, and that says everything about the skill and gentle touch of the groomer.

Thank you for treating my Frenchie like royalty! You’ve earned a forever client, and I’ll be recommending you to every dog parent I know!

This was my first time bringing Lola to Evie at Scissors and Suds, and she did a FANTASTIC job of making Lola look and feel so good!! She gave a perfect haircut, and Lola is ready for summer! The prices are excellent and scheduling was a breeze! I’m so glad I found a great place to bring Lola!
Evil was so great! She let me bring both my babies at the last minute without an appointment and she did a fantastic job grooming them!! I will always take my girls there.

Wow, she is really good! She's possibly the only groomer in the area that actually knows how to do some of the less common breed styles, as no one else could do a decent Bedlington head. My dog looks absolutely beautiful, exactly as I wanted, and absolutely adores her. She is so sweet and gentle with the dogs. Timely without rushing, and does absolutely beautiful grooming. Very reasonably priced, as well. I made an appointment to come back and will continue to do so. 💯 % recommend! She even did a holiday photo shoot and sent me this lovely photo of my darling dog.

This place is awesome. If you have a four legged family member take them here. We took our Shakira a Shih Tzu here and they knocked it out of the park. The staff is so friendly and professional it’s unreal .Good old fashion customer service. I explained what I wanted as far as grooming goes and the groomer was spot on. I had been going to another groomer for the past two years, but this place has made me a life time customer. You have to give these folks a try. You won’t be disappointed.Thanks guys for taking great care of our Shakira.

JXQ
EV did the best job on my Standard Poodle! They are always friendly and knowledgeable. She knows the correct cut for the breed. He looks great!

Absolutely grade A Service! Not only they accommodate to my work schedule, which is very unpredictable and hectic, but they got my Dog done in record time and made him look like a brand new man! Definitely ready to go for the holidays and I will be using you guys for now on.
Really great place!   Great service, customer service.  Dog show quality!!!

Evie is so very wonderful! We have had really bad experiences with dog groomers in town with an anxious dog who truly hates her paws being touched. She’s been sent home from various groomers who did nothing but complain about my dog's anxiety.

Evie has completely changed our grooming experience. The first time Evie groomed Rainey she put such care into everything she did that Rainey came home ready to play as if nothing happened. AN INCREDIBLE CHANGE!

I can’t recommend this place and Evie enough! If I could give 100 stars I absolutely would!
Pet friendly neighborhood groomers +
EV and the rest of the team at Scissors & Suds are awesome! My Scottie always looks great after his groom!

My dog got her best groom EVER here.

Taking your dog here is truly taking them to a *SHOW QUALITY* groomer, and I haven’t found anywhere else in San Antonio you can get such a perfect breed standard groom… especially at this price, which I found incredibly reasonable ($130-ish for an Airedale Terrier full groom, and other places routinely charge $180-$250+).

I took my Airedale here after the chain-store groomers kept blowdrying her coat backward to make it “fluffy,” which is 100% wrong for an Airedale Terrier. I wish I had found Scissors and Suds sooner!

I am an avid review reader, so I did notice some complaints about the “inconvenience” of a cash/check business. Y’all, that saves you $$$.

Support your local small businesses, because the factory-style big-box groomers are nowhere near this quality!

- A Happy Repeat Customer ❤️🐾
EV did a wonderful job with my Luna. She is an anxious pup and Evie and the rest of the staff were very patient with her! Thank you Scissors & Suds!
My pup and I love this place. They always cut exactly how I ask them to and the staff is super friendly and knowledgeable.
Just had my poodle, Lexus groomed and they did a fantastic job. She is a senior girl and they were very gentle with her. She looks fantastic and the price was extremely reasonable!
